description: This file contains a report implementation for 'Product Bundle Balance' in ERPNext, including functions to fetch item details, stock balances, and generate report data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the product bundle balance report data and columns.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches item details, product bundle details, parent and child items based on filters.

methods.name: get_stock_balance
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries and computes stock balance per item and warehouse.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database based on filters and items.

methods.name: get_parent_item_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for parent item selection based on filters.

methods.name: get_sle_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for stock ledger entries based on filters, especially date and warehouse.
